responsibility: Declares the derive expander specialized for builtin #[derive(PartialEq)]. It defines the DerivePartialEq visitor class, the helper interface for building the eq associated function, assembling field-pair comparison expressions, and generating PartialEq plus StructuralPartialEq impls, as well as enum match-case builders and the visit hooks used by macro expansion to derive equality behavior from different Rust item shapes.
same_name_distinction: Declaration file for the PartialEq derive expander: it specifies DerivePartialEq, the SelfOther helper structure, and match/equality builder APIs, whereas rust-derive-partial-eq.cc provides the actual comparison-expression and impl-construction logic.
